coverage_notes: All supplied observations/CSV records considered. Initial Poppler rendering of the long original path failed with I/O Error: Couldn't open file. Rendering a short-named byte-identical copy (SHA-256 verified) succeeded; PDF pp.1,2,4 actually viewed, including both registered anchors. Fingerprint remains that of the original PDF.
shared_qualifications: C1: Nominal atomic/molar coefficients are converted only for chemistry comparison: wt.%_i = 100*n_i*M_i / sum(n_j*M_j), over the complete stated formula. CIAAW abridged standard atomic weights 2024: Al 26.982, Co 58.933, Cr 51.996, Fe 55.845, Ni 58.693, Si 28.085, B 10.81 (https://ciaaw.org/abridged-atomic-weights.htm). Calculated nominal wt.% is not a measured analysis.

The registered primary text reports -0.56 V vs Ag/AgCl; the registered Fig.5 Epit guide reads approximately -0.68 V on the same scale, a 120 mV internal source disagreement. Both locations are retained.
Methods (PDF p.2) identify Ag/AgCl but omit its filling solution and reference-electrode temperature. No Ag/AgCl-to-SCE offset is fitted to CRA -602 mV. Numerical comparison is not_comparable.

The solution is artificial sea salt dissolved in distilled water at a 1:30 mass ratio, not an established 1:30 seawater dilution. No sea-salt recipe, chloride molarity or pH is supplied for conversion.

evidence.comparison: Scaling alone gives -560 and approximately -680 mV vs Ag/AgCl; neither is yet an SCE value. Filling solution and reference temperature are unspecified, so -602 mV(SCE) cannot be defensibly compared numerically.

matches.notes: Equiatomic alloy family plus the exact 520 C SPS sequence, 1:30 artificial-sea-salt medium and 3 mV/s scan identify CRA 592 (PDF pp.1-2,4). Calculated nominal Al is about 15 wt.% versus CRA 14 wt.%; this discrepancy is retained. The two registered readings disagree; neither is substituted or corrected. The 1080 C material is not this registered outcome.
